## #drp
```{r}
command_block_doc_helper <- function(dat, cdb_args) {
  cdb_class <- command_block_classes[command_block_classes$keyword == cdb_args_raw$X1[1], ][["command_block"]]
  class(cdb_args_raw) <- c(cdb_class, class(cdb_args_raw))
  cdb_args <- cdb_args_raw %>% parse_command_args()
  m0 <- Mapping$new()
  m0$dat_mod <- dat
  
  arg_list <- list(
    cdb = structure(
      list(),
      class = cdb_class
    ),
    mapping = m0
  ) %>% append(
    cdb_args
  )
  do.call(apply_command, arg_list)  
  
  list(
    command_block_class = cdb_class,
    cdb_args = cdb_args,
    result = m0$dat_mod
  )
  
}
```


```{r}
dat <- tibble(id = 1:3, x = 4:6)

cdb_args_raw <- tibble(X1 = "#VARL", X2 = "x", X3 = "assigned variable label")

res <- command_block_doc_helper(dat, cdb_args_raw)
res$command_block_class
res$cdb_args
res$result
res$result$x
```
